issue.title: macos-ci-check GateTests exhaust tiny wall-clock deadlines under suite load
issue.description: In linked bob-mac-capture, Scripts/test_macos_ci_check.py runs mocked git/gh subprocesses with default discovery=2s, total=6s, command=3s (lines 478-480). GateTests.test_cancelled_run, test_colored_json_empty_then_matching_run, and test_completed_run_waits_for_lagging_job_status were reported by bob-cli-oe.8.4 note #1 to fail in full just check-scripts with deadline reached before starting an external command, then pass in isolation on clean bf590f32 in about 3s. Those files are unchanged by the jump-pin epic. Landing independently ran the whole Python module on 109c30db: 43 tests pass in 46.030s. Root cause scope: tiny real-time budgets in subprocess-based mocked tests are vulnerable to scheduler delay. Stabilize non-timeout scenarios using a deterministic clock or sufficient isolated test budgets while preserving explicit deadline/cancellation tests and production timeout behavior. One task covers these three cases because they share the harness cause. All-status filename/error searches, last-week task sweep, and all active epic scopes reviewed; no semantic duplicate or causal active epic.

task_type_fields.evidence: Phase oe.8.4 note #1: three failures in one full check-scripts run, all three pass isolated on clean bf590f32; exact failure rate beyond this report unknown. Lander: full 43-test module passes unchanged at 109c30db in 46.030s; no fresh failure claimed.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by bob-cli-oe.8.4 note #1; three existing CI-gate unit cases failed under full check-scripts and passed unchanged in isolation. This landing independently confirmed all 43 script tests pass and found no duplicate or causally owning active epic.
